text:
Alice: Heads-up: planning to enable per-customer allowlist toggle for 'contract-gated-billing' tomorrow 09:30 PT. Quick checklist + guardrails below. Ping me if concerns. :eyes:

Ben: Do we have a canary audience? I can run this on 3 VIP accounts + 5 non-prod tenants.

Carla: Quick question — which API should callers use to check the customer-level flag? Current idea:
```
if customer_flags.get(customer_id, 'contract-gated-billing'):
    allow_feature()
else:
    deny_or_fallback()
```
Do we want a middleware layer instead?

deploy-bot: scheduled window open: 2026-03-17T16:00Z for internal toggles.

Alice: Guardrails: only flip for customers with enterprise_contract_id != null AND allowlist contains the toggle_key. Rollout plan: canary (3 VIP + 5 staging) -> 10% (selected accounts) -> 100% over 24h if metrics OK. Telemetry: emit flag.eval, feature.usage, token-spend.delta.

Eva: QA checklist: run e2e on staging with mocked contracts, verify no unexpected billing events, and validate fallback behavior.

Ben: I'll add the permission check in the auth middleware. Proposal: soft-fail to old behavior (default OFF) unless contract explicitly allows. Also will add logs with `flag_source=contract_allowlist` for observability.

Frank: Add alerts: if error rate > 1% OR token spend delta > +20% for canary accounts, automatic rollback to OFF. Also correlate with latency > 500ms for 5m.

Alice: +1. Legal sign-off required for VIP contract changes — @legal please confirm there are no special clauses.

Carla: PR #3421 pushed to add `customer_flag_service` and rollout CLI. Link: https://git.redwood/rdw/pr/3421 — @Ben can you review?

Ben: On it. Will review in ~30m.

deploy-bot: curl example to flip a flag for a single customer:
```
curl -X POST https://api.internal.redwood/flags/flip \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"key":"contract-gated-billing","customer_id":"acct-123","value":true}'
```

Alice: Operational note: set immediate rollback on 5xx or sustained latency >500ms for 5m. Keep manual override enabled for SRE.

Eva: I'll build a temporary canary dashboard (latency, 5xx rate, token-usage, billing delta) and post link here once ready.

Carla: PR updated after Ben's review and merged. Marking backend ready for canary.

Ben: Deployed to canary customers. Observability looks clean so far — no anomalies in the first 20m. :thumbsup:

Alice: Thanks — if no regressions in 6h we'll proceed to 10% rollout. I'll create the policy for the gradual ramp and post the schedule.
